name: io.github.IngTian/witness
title: witness
description: Distills your sessions or any text corpus into a dated history of how its subject changed.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.note: Local stdio server. On first run it downloads a local embedding model (~470MB) in the background; search_observations answers once it lands, and the other tools work at once. Distillation uses your own Claude Code / OpenCode auth, whichever you bound, so session text goes only to the provider you already chose. Prebuilt binaries: darwin-arm64, linux-x64, win32-x64, win32-arm64.
